name: Decentralized End-to-End Encrypted Storage
description: A self-hosted Dropbox/Drive alternative that stores files across a peer-to-peer network instead of a central server. Files are client-side split into chunks, end-to-end encrypted, and distributed across many independent nodes so that no single node ever holds a whole file or any plaintext. Redundant chunk placement lets the system tolerate node loss while preserving confidentiality and availability.

nodes.name: P2P Encrypted Storage System
nodes.description: Decentralized, distributed, end-to-end encrypted storage system running over a peer-to-peer network. Files are split into chunks, encrypted on the client, and spread across many independent nodes so no single node holds a complete file or any plaintext. Redundant, distributed chunk placement provides fault tolerance against node loss without a central server.
